# DayTree

> A minimal, brutalist habit tracker designed for high performers. Plan your day, track your consistency, and grow your personal tree of daily disciplines.

## Core Navigation

- [Landing Page](https://daytree.paanipoorie.com/): The homepage of the app explaining product features and value.
- [Login Page](https://daytree.paanipoorie.com/login): Log in to your DayTree account.
- [Signup Page](https://daytree.paanipoorie.com/signup): Create a free account.
